query: My employer physically assaulted me in the office and is threatening to beat me up if I come back. What legal section allows me to hit him back?

model_output.summary: You are facing a serious criminal situation involving physical assault and threats from your employer at the office. Please note that Indian law does not allow anyone to take the law into their own hands or hit someone back as retaliation. Because your situation involves criminal aspects and physical threats, you must contact the police and a lawyer immediately.
facts_extracted: Employer physically assaulted the user in the office
Employer is threatening further physical violence if the user returns
User asked for a legal section allowing retaliation

options.title: Contact Police and Legal Aid
options.description: Report the physical assault and threats to the local police immediately for protection and criminal investigation. You may also be eligible for free legal services as a workman under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
pros: Ensures personal safety and police protection
Official record of the crime committed against you
cons: Can be a stressful process requiring police follow-up
options.forum: Local Police Station / District Legal Services Authority (DLSA / NALSA Helpline 15100)

citations.relevance: Provides criteria for industrial workmen and citizens to access free legal services and aid through the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).

model_output.lawyer_reason: The dispute involves criminal aspects, physical threats, and personal safety concerns, which require immediate intervention by criminal defense or labor advocates and local law enforcement. Additionally, the verified authority does not cover criminal provisions for assault.
